## New to this theme? {#why-this-theme-matters}

Speech evidence can resolve a visual ambiguity, but fluent text can still be
wrong, incomplete, translated from the wrong source, or supplied with a
misleading provenance label. A transcript comparison is interpretable only
when it holds frames, model, prompt, and decoding fixed and records how each
text was produced.

For example, a question asking “what did the speaker say?” needs **lexical
speech**—the words—not merely frames or tone of voice. **ASR** converts audio
to timestamped text, but a plausible sentence can omit the needed phrase. An
automatic transcript, uploader caption, dataset reference, and independently
reviewed human transcript are therefore different evidence tiers.

<span id="technical-summary" class="legacy-fragment-alias" aria-hidden="true"></span>

## Current working answer

Use quality-gated Whisper large-v3 as a **Routed candidate** for selected
lexical-speech questions, with a matched frame-only control. Do not treat its
acceptance rule as language recognition or fidelity. Keep the strict
independently produced human-transcript tier **Blocked** until independent
transcriber/reviewer records exist.

::: {.theme-decision-strip aria-label="Transcript decisions"}
- **Use now:** quality-accepted Whisper only for declared lexical-speech work, with a frame-only control.
- **Do not default:** transcripts on every question or mechanical acceptance as proof of fidelity.
- **Still possible:** alternative ASR, grounded spans, dataset-reference controls, and a valid human upper bound.
- **Next tests:** the distribution-level selective-Whisper route with
  deterministic fallback and an independently frozen comparison. Do not scale
  the completed two-video Gemini 3.7 smoke; revisit Gemini only for a targeted
  unresolved temporal or speech hypothesis with a matched control.
:::

## Evidence at a glance

- **Selected diagnostic:** accepted Whisper improved 4/10 to 7/10 on ten
  lexical-speech rows; this is not a prevalence estimate.
- **Qwen quality diagnostic:** a fresh eight-row corrected-harness batch
  completed `6/8`; two rows returned empty text, so the frozen result is
  `not_ready` and no Qwen-versus-Whisper score exists.
- **Qwen mechanism diagnostic:** a separate four-row frozen test reproduced
  both baseline empty outputs under automatic language and completed `4/4`
  with forced English; its authorized fresh-panel action is now complete.
- **Fresh Qwen aligned-English result:** forced English completed and aligned
  `12/12` new rows, but exact official-answer-phrase containment was `0/12`
  for both Qwen and frozen Whisper. The frozen calculation reproduces, but a
  post-hoc audit found the panel construct-invalid for ASR quality: only one
  task directly requested a recoverable literal phrase or name, while ten did
  not support exact transcript containment. Qwen is not promoted.
- **Failure mechanisms:** text can miss non-lexical events or contain the right
  token without changing the answer.
- **Blocked:** a human-transcript upper bound lacks independent producer and
  reviewer provenance.
- **Condition boundary:** a one-row Seamless result does not reject alternative
  or multilingual ASR families.

## What has been tried

### Transcript provenance tiers {#transcript-provenance-tiers}

Define the tiers before comparing them:

1. **automatic ASR output** — text generated by a specified ASR system from
   the frozen media;
2. **uploader caption** — text supplied by the uploader, with its own unknown
   authoring and alignment properties;
3. **dataset recording-prompt reference** — a dataset-supplied reference for
   the recording prompt, not evidence of an independent transcript review;
4. **independently produced human transcript** — a transcript with independent
   transcriber and reviewer provenance records.

No tier may be relabeled as another. In particular, a dataset
recording-prompt reference is not a TRECVID human oracle.

### Automatic transcript ablation {#automatic-transcript-ablation}

- **Reason for testing:** an early transcript changed an answer, but the
  project needed a label-blind matched test of accepted ASR on lexical speech.
- **Tested condition and panel:** identical 12-frame Qwen requests with and
  without a quality-accepted Whisper large-v3 transcript on ten selected
  lexical-speech rows; all 20 predictions froze before scoring.
- **Observed result:** manual accuracy changed from `4/10` to `7/10`, with
  three rescues and no observed degradation on that selected lexical-speech
  panel.
- **Current condition-bound status:** **Routed candidate** for quality-gated
  lexical speech; not a global transcript default.
- **What this rules out now:** dismissing quality-accepted ASR as having no
  diagnostic value on the tested selected lexical-speech panel.
- **What it does not rule out:** routing prevalence, global transcript value,
  non-lexical vocalization performance, transcript-fidelity failures, or 2026
  accuracy.
- **Possible defect, audit gap, or uncertainty:** **Uncertainty**—the selected
  ten-row panel cannot establish prevalence or a global policy.
- **Reconsider when:** a representative label-blind routing panel measures
  accepted and rejected ASR strata, including regressions, under one frozen
  decision rule.

<details>
<summary>Method, result, validity risks, and evidence</summary>

The selected ten-row diagnostic does not estimate routing prevalence, global
transcript value, non-lexical vocalization performance, or 2026 accuracy.
Transcript acceptance was mechanically label-blind; its validity is separate
from transcript fidelity. Separately, in frozen-30 protocol v2, the
Qwen12+Whisper arm led exact match at `11/30` and token F1 at `0.506795` across
the 30-row panel. That result supports reporting the transcript arm as a route
comparison; it does not establish a global Whisper policy or 2026 accuracy.
See the [automatic-transcript
report · Evidence of record · Evidence report · GitHub](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_video_2026/blob/814e55429f6dd1dc8570bc08f1dad849f74e36a1/reports/trecvid_vqa_2026/oracle_transcript_diagnostic_issue_7.md)
and its [frozen ablation plan · Evidence of record · Evidence report · GitHub](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_video_2026/blob/814e55429f6dd1dc8570bc08f1dad849f74e36a1/plans/issue-7-automatic-transcript-ablation.md).
</details>

### Qwen ASR plus forced-aligner quality diagnostic {#qwen-aligner-quality-diagnostic}

- **Reason for testing:** determine whether the locally cached Qwen3-ASR plus
  Qwen3-ForcedAligner path can complete a fresh English exact-speech panel
  under the corrected offline ROCm contract.
- **Tested condition and panel:** one label-free batch of eight fresh English
  WAV rows, excluding prior Qwen rows; the pinned ASR and aligner revisions,
  audio hashes, order, runner, cache bindings, and one-attempt limit were
  frozen before execution.
- **Observed result:** the container exited `0` at `$0.00` paid cost, but only
  `6/8` rows completed with valid aligned sequences. The remaining `2/8`
  returned deterministic `Qwen3-ASR returned empty text` failures. The frozen
  decision is `not_ready`; no annotations or Whisper text were opened.
- **Current condition-bound status:** **Blocked diagnostic**—this is an
  incomplete-output result, not a Qwen-versus-Whisper comparison.
- **What this rules out now:** the claim that the corrected harness itself
  cannot run a multi-row batch; six rows completed and aligned successfully.
- **What it does not establish:** transcript fidelity, timestamp accuracy,
  Whisper replacement, downstream VQA improvement, or a model ranking.
- **Reconsider when:** the empty-output behavior is resolved in a separately
  frozen attempt and the full paired panel completes under the same evidence
  contract; do not retry or relabel this root.

<details>
<summary>Method, result, validity risks, and evidence</summary>

The private root is preserved under
`data/vqa/benchmarks/model-verifier-canaries-20260814/stage05d-qwen-aligner-quality-v1/`.
Maximum allocated device memory was `6,161,528,320` bytes and container
elapsed time was `64.105` seconds. Because the `8/8` operational gate failed,
the scorer did not load answer annotations or the frozen Whisper text. The
result is therefore valid only as a zero-cost incomplete-output diagnostic.
</details>

### Qwen empty-output mechanism diagnostic {#qwen-empty-output-mechanism-diagnostic}

- **Reason for testing:** localize the preserved empty-output behavior before
  authorizing another quality comparison, while keeping the original Stage
  0.5d attempt immutable.
- **Tested condition and panel:** four rows selected from frozen Stage 0.5d
  results in request order—two preserved empty failures and the first two
  passing controls—then run once through four process-isolated arms. Arms held the
  pinned Qwen revisions, audio bytes, ROCm runtime, read-only mounts,
  `--network none`, and `$0.00` paid compute fixed.
- **Observed result:** the aligned automatic-language baseline A reproduced
  `2` failures and `2` valid aligned successes. The no-aligner B and
  aligner-without-timestamps C explanatory arms also each had `2` failures
  and `2` successes. The aligned-English treatment D completed `4/4` with
  valid alignment. All arm terminals exited `0` and were contract-valid.
- **Current condition-bound status:** **Mechanism result retained; authorized
  follow-up completed.** The four diagnostic rows remain unscored, and the
  separate fresh aligned-English result is recorded below.
- **What this rules out now:** on this frozen four-row panel, the failures
  were not localized to merely loading the aligner or requesting timestamps;
  each automatic-language explanatory arm remained at `2` successes and `2`
  failures, and neither restored all four rows. This supports a bounded
  automatic-language path association, not an internal causal bug claim.
- **What it does not establish:** a general Qwen model defect, transcript
  quality, Whisper replacement value, downstream VQA improvement, or a model
  ranking. The result is not a quality comparison.
- **Possible defect, audit gap, or uncertainty:** **Uncertainty**—the evidence
  is a four-row outcome-selected mechanism diagnostic and identifies an
  automatic-language path association only under this pinned condition.
  **Confirmed protocol deviation, corrected after the run:** the original
  selector redundantly read private transcript/alignment fields on rows already
  marked passed, contrary to the metadata-only design. It copied none of those
  values, and no labels or scoring inputs were opened. The frozen Stage 0.5d
  aggregate had already certified all six passed rows as completed and
  alignment-valid, so metadata-only reselection yields the same first two
  controls and does not change this aggregate mechanism result.
- **Reconsider when:** resolved by the separately frozen Stage 0.5f panel
  below. Do not reuse these four rows or reopen this frozen root.

<details>
<summary>Method, result, validity risks, and evidence</summary>

The frozen diagnostic is `qwen-aligner-stage05e-20260816-empty-output-v1`
with schema `qwen-empty-output-diagnostic.v1`. Arm wall times were 46.722,
46.691, 46.294, and 47.787 seconds for A through D; maximum peak memory was
6,175,102,976, 4,331,441,664, 6,175,102,464, and 6,174,173,184 bytes. The
input-freeze SHA-256 is
`aed463e5c6f206e346c29b41b56b7199f07874981ffadc908d41974cf0466083` and the
freeze-payload SHA-256 is
`d157e6dc2187ea14d7ead4f42f8ee2d8c14dddc8707acd314d1e7c4a02fe57ec`.
The sanitized aggregate is in
[`qwen-aligner-quality-20260816/`](../../docs/experiments/artifacts/qwen-aligner-quality-20260816/),
with the additive Stage 0.5e record in
[`diagnostic-summary.json`](../../docs/experiments/artifacts/qwen-aligner-quality-20260816/diagnostic-summary.json).
No labels, annotations, Whisper text, or scoring inputs were opened. Row-level
Qwen outputs remained private and were never manually inspected or scored.
Post-run review found that deterministic validation and the original host
selector did programmatically read transcript/alignment fields; the selector's
access was a protocol deviation because the design required metadata-only
selection. It copied none of those values. Stage 0.5d's frozen aggregate
certified all six passed rows as completed and alignment-valid, so the
corrected metadata-only selector yields the same first two controls. Neither
frozen experiment was rerun, and the earlier Stage 0.5d `summary.json` remains
unchanged.
</details>

### Fresh aligned-English Qwen quality panel {#fresh-aligned-english-qwen-quality-panel}

- **Reason for testing:** complete the Stage 0.5e authorized action and test
  whether forced English both removes empty output on new Qwen3-ASR rows and
  yields more complete official answer phrases than frozen Whisper.
- **Tested condition and panel:** one fresh 12-row panel selected label-blind
  from the ordered 475-row question/identity manifest with fixed `6`
  reported-speech, `3` conversation, and `3` vocalization quotas. A complete
  private marker census excluded prior Qwen3-ASR and oracle identities and
  hash-bound two preserved preparation-only roots that never began inference.
  The one local attempt fixed the pinned ASR/aligner revisions, forced English,
  timestamps, ROCm BF16/SDPA runtime, media hashes/order, read-only mounts,
  `--network none`, and `$0.00` paid compute.
- **Observed result:** the sole process exited `0`; `12/12` rows completed and
  `12/12` had valid bounded alignments. Only after that freeze, exact contiguous
  normalized official-answer-phrase containment scored Qwen `0/12` and frozen
  Whisper `0/12`: both present `0`, Qwen only `0`, Whisper only `0`, and
  neither present `12`.
- **Current condition-bound status:** **Operationally complete;
  construct-invalid for ASR quality; not promoted.** The historical frozen
  fields remain `ready_for_quality_test` and `no_directional_difference`, but
  the post-hoc validity audit supersedes that quality interpretation without
  changing the score.
- **What this rules out now:** another same-condition completion diagnostic,
  promotion from this exact phrase-containment comparison, and scaling the
  same selector/metric combination. Forced English completed this fresh panel
  without an empty-output failure.
- **What it does not establish:** WER, transcript fidelity, timestamp accuracy,
  general English robustness, Whisper replacement, downstream VQA value, or a
  model ranking. The all-neither tie does not imply equal transcript quality.
- **Possible defect, audit gap, or uncertainty:** **Confirmed construct
  defect**—official VQA answers are not transcript references, and the
  question-keyword selector did not ensure literal spoken-answer tasks. A
  private read-only audit classified one direct literal-phrase/name request,
  one semantic conversation request, and ten tasks that did not support exact
  transcript containment.
- **Reconsider when:** a separately designed test has independently grounded
  transcript references or a frozen downstream VQA decision rule. Do not
  scale or rerun this same containment comparison.

<details>
<summary>Method, result, validity risks, and evidence</summary>

The private exposure census classified all `57` Qwen3-ASR marker matches as
`52` genuine exposure files plus five marker-bearing files in two exact
preparation-only roots. The ledger bound all six files in those roots, zero
attempt artifacts, 12 prepared identities, a replay fingerprint, and `16`
excluded prior/oracle identities. Immediately before the sole record
transition, the controller reverified that census, the canonical manifest and
index byte hashes, the selection replay, every WAV hash and duration, the
committed controller, runner/helper, model snapshots, image, and command.

The run used controller revision
`d9e43c94c2e441f5bc85508ed1b41d738e33289f`, took `110.416` seconds wall time,
summed `102.241` row-inference seconds, and recorded maximum allocated memory
of `6,162,299,392` bytes. Predictions froze before the scorer opened canonical
annotations and checksum-bound frozen Whisper. Row identities, questions,
answers, transcripts, and row-level scores remain private. A later read-only
audit reproduced every source binding and stored boolean. All 12 Qwen outputs
were non-empty; the quality gates accepted `8/12` Qwen and `10/12` Whisper
outputs; and raw Whisper had one exact hit that the frozen timestamp gate
excluded. Mean unordered official-answer token recall was `0.035` Qwen and
`0.212` Whisper, post-hoc and non-promotional. Evidence validity is therefore
**operationally valid but construct-invalid for ASR quality**. This result
completes the action authorized by Stage 0.5e without superseding the Stage
0.5d incomplete-output observation or Stage 0.5e mechanism result.

The private root is
`data/vqa/benchmarks/model-verifier-canaries-20260814/stage05f-qwen-aligned-english-quality-v1/`.
The sanitized, hash-bound aggregate is
[`aligned-english-summary.json`](../../docs/experiments/artifacts/qwen-aligner-quality-20260816/aligned-english-summary.json).
The sanitized correction is
[`aligned-english-metric-audit.json`](../../docs/experiments/artifacts/qwen-aligner-quality-20260816/aligned-english-metric-audit.json).
</details>

### Completed Gemini 3.7 Flash native-AV compatibility smoke {#gemini-37-flash-native-av-smoke}

This is a separate two-video diagnostic, not an arm of the Qwen experiment.
Stable `gemini-3.7-flash` and `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` received the same WebM
bytes and direct-answer prompt at four FPS. Both returned `2/2` non-empty
answers and both arms had `42,842` prompt tokens inside the frozen custom-FPS
band; observed cost was `$0.067445`.

The immutable strict freeze is `not_ready` only because Batch reported the
exact requested model aliases instead of the catalog's separate dated version
strings. A bounded no-new-inference diagnostic preserved that decision and
found both arms semantically correct on both rows in an unblinded manual
check. Exact match was `0/2` for both; Flash won one token-F1 comparison and
lost one, averaging `0.2496` versus `0.4365` for 3.1 Pro. Flash was more
verbose, and the two-row result supplies no quality separation or scale-up
signal. See the [sanitized aggregate](../../docs/experiments/artifacts/gemini37-flash-two-video-smoke-20260816/summary.json).

### Matched full-panel frame/audio audit {#matched-full-panel-frame-audio-audit}

- **Reason for testing:** determine whether quality-gated Whisper helps when it
  is added to the same 12-frame Qwen3.5-4B request across the complete locally
  available labeled panel, while preserving enough visual/audio evidence to
  inspect failures.
- **Tested condition and panel:** 475 VQA 2025 training rows with local media;
  identical 12 selected frames in a frames-only control and a frames-plus-
  accepted-Whisper-large-v3 treatment. Predictions froze remotely before
  references were joined locally. Six annotation rows without local media
  were excluded; VTT captions/search data were not part of this panel.
- **Observed result:** Whisper was accepted on 424/475 rows. Frames-only scored
  `0.092632` exact match, `0.243914` token F1, and `0.152985` lexical METEOR;
  frames plus Whisper scored `0.141053`, `0.304860`, and `0.215266`.
  Paired deltas were `+0.048421` exact match, `+0.060946` token F1, and
  `+0.062282` METEOR, with 27 exact-match wins and 4 losses.
- **Current condition-bound status:** **Routed candidate**—the full-panel
  result supports using accepted Whisper as additional evidence for declared
  lexical-speech or explanation questions, but not as an unconditional answer
  source. One reviewed row showed a clear content regression from unrelated
  audio; several other exact-match losses were semantic or formatting variants.
- **What this rules out now:** the claim that accepted Whisper has no useful
  downstream value at distribution level under this matched panel.
- **What it does not rule out:** a better router, event-aware frame sampling,
  stronger answerer, transcript fidelity, or benefit on VQA 2026/test data.
- **Possible defect, audit gap, or uncertainty:** **Audit gap**—all 435 rows
  with an exact-match error are indexed, but manual visual/transcript review
  covered 48 rows (all 31 transition rows plus 17 both-wrong examples). Raw
  audio playback was unavailable in the runtime; the audio-side review used
  timestamped Whisper text and source-media provenance.
- **Reconsider when:** a routed comparison freezes a deterministic
  question/transcript relevance policy plus a shuffled-transcript negative
  control and meets predeclared non-degradation and paired-gain thresholds on
  this same labeled panel. The next route should fall back to frames-only when
  relevance fails; broader frames or a larger model come after this control.

<details>
<summary>Method, result, validity risks, and evidence</summary>

The remote run used one CUDA Whisper translation pass and two Qwen conditions
with the same model revision, prompt, frame requests, and decoding limit. The
remote output contained 12 selected-frame contact sheets per video, exact
selected PTS, per-frame hashes, audio hashes/durations, timestamped Whisper
output, prediction files, summaries, and a verified `SHA256SUMS` manifest. The
paired confidence intervals are exploratory bootstrap intervals over 2,000
resamples with seed `20260803`; they are not a held-out test estimate. The
[full-panel score artifact](../experiments/artifacts/qwen35-4b-12f-whisper-frame-audit-20260803-c2.json)
  contains the reproducible aggregate result. Among 424 quality-accepted
  transcripts, Whisper changed 307 answer strings; token F1 increased on 122
  rows and decreased on 58, reinforcing that mechanical ASR acceptance is not
  a relevance gate. The private row-level audit and
contact sheets remain under the local shared data benchmark directory; the
execution record is in the [matched frame/audio audit plan](../../plans/qwen35-whisper-frame-audit.md).
</details>

### Multilingual and translation follow-ups {#multilingual-translation-followups}

- **Reason for testing:** determine whether the intended non-English-to-English
  ASR route was sufficiently evidenced for multilingual claims.
- **Tested condition and panel:** frozen-30 Whisper `task="translate"` on 30
  requests, plus follow-up research and a proposed language-stratified design;
  there was no human language/transcript reference panel.
- **Observed result:** 29 mechanically accepted outputs could be attached to
  matched requests, but the completed mixed panel lacked source-language labels
  and transcript/translation references.
- **Current condition-bound status:** compatibility evidence for the route;
  **not** multilingual robustness or transcript-fidelity evidence.
- **What this rules out now:** claiming multilingual robustness or translation
  fidelity from the completed mixed frozen-30 route.
- **What it does not rule out:** benefit for a declared language, dialect, or
  translation condition under human-referenced evaluation.
- **Possible defect, audit gap, or uncertainty:** **Audit gap**—the completed
  panel lacks source-language and independently reviewed transcript references.
- **Reconsider when:** a source-language-stratified panel with independent
  transcript and translation references completes under matched controls.

<details>
<summary>Method, result, validity risks, and evidence</summary>

The Latin-script/rate gate can accept fluent but incorrect English, accept an
untranslated Latin-script language, and reject legitimate names or mixed
scripts. A proposed 30-clip multilingual diagnostic needs human-verified source
language, source transcript, and English translation, then matched visual-only
and Whisper conditions. See the [multilingual follow-up · Evidence of record · Evidence report · GitHub](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_video_2026/blob/814e55429f6dd1dc8570bc08f1dad849f74e36a1/reports/trecvid_vqa_2026/multilingual_qwen36_followup_2026-07-24.md),
[ASR options · Evidence of record · Evidence report · GitHub](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_video_2026/blob/814e55429f6dd1dc8570bc08f1dad849f74e36a1/reports/trecvid_vqa_2026/asr_model_followup_options_2026-07-20.md),
and [frozen-30 report · Evidence of record · Evidence report · GitHub](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_video_2026/blob/814e55429f6dd1dc8570bc08f1dad849f74e36a1/reports/trecvid_vqa_2026/native_audio_model_benchmark_results_2026-07-21.md).
</details>

### Seamless diagnostic {#seamless-diagnostic}

- **Reason for testing:** countercheck Whisper translation on the difficult
  speech example with a different speech-to-text translation family.
- **Tested condition and panel:** one speech example with identical frozen
  12-frame Qwen evidence and a SeamlessM4T-v2 large transcript.
- **Observed result:** the English output was materially incomplete and the
  downstream answer remained wrong; relative to frames-only, token F1 and
  METEOR decreased.
- **Current condition-bound status:** **Not promoted under the tested
  condition**; a one-example diagnostic, not an ASR accuracy estimate.
- **What this rules out now:** advancing SeamlessM4T-v2 large as the selected
  speech route on that one controlled example.
- **What it does not rule out:** another language, model revision, panel, or
  independently verified translation route.
- **Possible defect, audit gap, or uncertainty:** **Uncertainty**—one example
  cannot estimate alternative-ASR fidelity or downstream value.
- **Reconsider when:** a matched, independently reviewable multilingual panel
  shows faithful evidence and a predeclared downstream improvement.

<details>
<summary>Method, result, validity risks, and evidence</summary>

The reference was joined only after exact-capture inference. The output's
mechanical rule pass was not treated as semantic credibility: it omitted later
speech evidence needed for the answer. The result does not rule out another
language, model revision, panel, or independently verified translation route.
See the [Seamless follow-up · Evidence of record · Evidence report · GitHub](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_video_2026/blob/814e55429f6dd1dc8570bc08f1dad849f74e36a1/reports/trecvid_vqa_2026/seamless_audio_followup_results_2026-07-21.md).
</details>

### External dataset-reference research {#external-dataset-reference-research}

- **Reason for testing:** specify a provenance-safe control that can compare
  automatic ASR against a dataset recording-prompt reference.
- **Tested condition and panel:** research design for a small external
  four-video, three-condition control; no TRECVID effectiveness result.
- **Observed result:** the design distinguishes frames-only, automatic-ASR,
  and dataset-reference text while freezing predictions before labels load.
- **Current condition-bound status:** an **Open hypothesis**; the design is not
  a TRECVID human oracle or an effectiveness result.
- **What this rules out now:** calling the proposed dataset-reference control a
  TRECVID human oracle or reporting it as an effectiveness result.
- **What it does not rule out:** a provenance-labeled, small external control
  that compares automatic ASR and dataset reference text.
- **Possible defect, audit gap, or uncertainty:** **Audit gap**—the design has
  not run and the dataset reference is not independent human transcription.
- **Reconsider when:** the declared three-condition protocol runs with frozen
  predictions, exact provenance, and no claim beyond its small panel.

<details>
<summary>Method, result, validity risks, and evidence</summary>

The external reference is a dataset-provided recording-prompt reference, not a
human transcriber/reviewer record. It must not pass a `human_verified_oracle`
validator or be called gold. The [external dataset-reference
research · Evidence of record · Evidence report · GitHub](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_video_2026/blob/814e55429f6dd1dc8570bc08f1dad849f74e36a1/reports/trecvid_vqa_2026/external_gold_transcript_benchmark_research_2026-07-24.md)
also specifies identical frames/model/prompt/decoding across conditions.
</details>

### Human-oracle tier {#human-oracle-tier}

- **Reason for testing:** estimate the upper bound from independently produced
  transcript evidence without leaking answer labels.
- **Tested condition and panel:** none yet; independent transcriber and
  reviewer records are absent.
- **Observed result:** no valid human-oracle result exists.
- **Current condition-bound status:** **Blocked** until independent provenance
  records and a label-blind protocol exist.
- **What this rules out now:** treating uploader captions, dataset references,
  or ASR agreement as a strict human-transcript upper bound.
- **What it does not rule out:** a valid independent human-transcript upper
  bound once its named provenance prerequisites exist.
- **Possible defect, audit gap, or uncertainty:** **Audit gap**—independent
  transcriber and reviewer provenance records are missing.
- **Reconsider when:** independent transcriber and reviewer records, a
  label-blind protocol, and matched downstream controls are complete.

<details>
<summary>Method, result, validity risks, and evidence</summary>

Uploader captions, ASR ensembles, and dataset references cannot substitute for
this tier. A true upper bound needs independent transcript production and
review, immutable provenance, matching downstream controls, and answer labels
loaded only after prediction freeze. There is no oracle result to compare or
cite.
</details>

## Known failures and cases

- [CASE-002 — Non-lexical event missed by transcript gate](failure-library.{{< meta report-ext >}}#case-002)
  shows that accepted text can be irrelevant to a requested vocal sound.
- [CASE-003 — Retrieved token unused by answerer](failure-library.{{< meta report-ext >}}#case-003)
  shows that a needed word can be present while the answer remains wrong.

### What the evidence supports

- On the selected ten lexical-speech rows, accepted Whisper changed manual
  accuracy from 4/10 to 7/10, with three rescues and no observed degradation.
- Transcript output can be included in a label-isolated request path while a
  rejected output becomes null.
- On the frozen four-row Qwen mechanism panel, forced English completed all
  rows while each automatic-language explanatory arm remained at `2` successes
  and `2` failures and neither restored all four rows; this was valid bounded
  mechanism evidence, not a quality result.
- On the subsequent fresh 12-row panel, forced English produced `12/12` valid
  aligned outputs without an empty-output failure. The preserved `0/12`
  versus `0/12` phrase result is construct-invalid for ASR quality because the
  selector admitted mostly tasks without a literal spoken answer; Qwen was
  not promoted.
- Fluent or mechanically accepted translation is not by itself faithful audio
  evidence; the Seamless diagnostic shows this distinction.
- Dataset recording-prompt references can be a separately labeled control, not
  a TRECVID human-oracle result.

### What it does not rule out

- The ten-row ablation does not establish global transcript use, route
  prevalence, multilingual effectiveness, or effects on non-lexical sound.
- The multilingual follow-up does not identify source languages or translation
  fidelity in frozen-30.
- The one-row Seamless result does not reject all alternative or multilingual
  ASR systems.
- The blocked human tier does not imply a zero upper bound; it means no valid
  upper-bound evidence exists yet.
- The four-row Qwen mechanism diagnostic does not establish a general model
  defect, transcript quality, downstream VQA value, or a Whisper comparison.
- The fresh Qwen `0`/`0` containment tie does not establish equal transcript
  fidelity, WER, timestamp accuracy, or downstream VQA value; its post-hoc
  audit confirms that official VQA answers and the selected tasks did not form
  a valid transcript-quality reference panel.

<span id="possible-bugs-confounds-and-audit-gaps" class="legacy-fragment-alias" aria-hidden="true"></span>

### Confirmed defects, audit gaps, and uncertainties

- **Uncertainty:** selected lexical-speech rows are diagnostic rather than a
  prevalence or global-accuracy sample.
- **Uncertainty:** the rate/Latin-script acceptance policy is not a language
  detector, an accuracy measure, or a human transcript review.
- **Audit gap:** no human source-language transcript or faithful translation
  reference is available for the completed multilingual route.
- **Confirmed construct defect:** the fresh Qwen aligned-English selector used
  speech-related question keywords, but ten of 12 selected tasks did not
  support exact transcript containment. Preserve the operational result and
  frozen score; do not reuse this selector/metric as an ASR quality test.
- **Blocked prerequisite:** the strict human tier lacks independent
  transcriber/reviewer provenance records; other text tiers must not fill that
  gap by renaming.

## Open hypotheses and ideas

- A prompt requiring timestamps and evidence spans may convert accepted lexical
  ASR into more grounded downstream answers than the current prompt.
- A label-blind human transcript can distinguish audio-evidence limits from
  ASR limits, but only if its provenance is independent.
- Alternative/multilingual ASR might help a declared stratum when compared on
  an identical frozen panel with explicit null and rejection controls.

## Cheapest valid next experiments

### Distribution-level selective Whisper route {#distribution-level-selective-whisper}

- **Hypothesis:** a question-only lexical-speech router can add accepted
  Whisper evidence where words are required while preserving the frame-only
  baseline on the rest of the 475-row development boundary.
- **Smallest valid panel or work item:** freeze the router over all 475 local
  VQA 2025 training rows before loading answers or using baseline failures to
  select cases. Run Whisper large-v3 only on routed rows; rejected or failed
  ASR must deterministically fall back to frames-only.
- **Matched controls and integrity safeguards:** generate and cache one
  versioned 12-frame evidence set per media hash, then run matched frames-only
  and accepted-transcript conditions from those same frame hashes. Keep the
  question-only route, ASR acceptance/rejection, transcript provenance, and
  model/prompt/decoding fixed and label-blind until every prediction freezes.
- **Decision or promotion rule:** every row must have a route or fallback and
  every routed pair must complete; accepted-ASR rows must improve token F1 by
  at least `0.10` and METEOR by at least `0.05` with non-decreasing exact
  match; the composed 475-row policy must not regress aggregate exact match
  or token F1; changed answers must show more rescues than degradations under
  a declared hard-negative review.
- **Boundary on what a positive result would establish:** a routed Whisper
  policy for this declared development boundary, not a global transcript
  default, ASR fidelity claim, or 2026 competition score.

<details>
<summary>Method, result, validity risks, and evidence</summary>

The completed full-panel Qwen3.5-4B run supplies the denominator and operational
baseline, but it did not preserve a reusable frame-pixel cache. The next run
should therefore validate a one-pass-per-video extractor and cache its frame
hashes before downstream comparison. On the measured L40S timings, one GPU is
adequate for this routed experiment; multiple GPUs become useful only after
shared preprocessing is immutable and several compute-heavy arms are genuinely
independent. Do not choose routed rows from baseline errors, because that would
bias the route estimate.
</details>

### Transcript grounding prompt

- **Hypothesis:** accepted Whisper plus a required timestamp/evidence-span
  grounding prompt improves lexical-speech answers over accepted Whisper with
  the current prompt.
- **Smallest valid panel or work item:** the existing accepted lexical-speech
  rows or a newly frozen matched subset, with both transcript prompts.
- **Matched controls and integrity safeguards:** same accepted Whisper output,
  frames, model, decoding, and question; retain a frame-only/null control;
  freeze all answers before labels and record the cited span.
- **Decision or promotion rule:** advance the grounding prompt only if a
  predeclared paired improvement occurs without degradation versus current
  accepted Whisper and controls.
- **Boundary on what a positive result would establish:** it would establish a
  prompt effect on that accepted-ASR panel, not transcript fidelity or global
  speech routing.

### Label-blind human-transcript upper bound

- **Hypothesis:** independently produced human transcripts reveal the maximum
  downstream value of faithful transcript evidence on a declared speech panel.
- **Smallest valid panel or work item:** a small frozen speech-critical panel
  with independent transcriber and reviewer records and explicit provenance.
- **Matched controls and integrity safeguards:** label-blind transcript work;
  same frames/model/prompt/decoding for frame-only, ASR, and human conditions;
  immutable provenance; and answer labels loaded only after all predictions
  freeze.
- **Decision or promotion rule:** interpret the human-minus-ASR and
  human-minus-frames deltas only if provenance and independent review records
  are complete for every included row.
- **Boundary on what a positive result would establish:** it would be an upper
  bound for the declared panel, not a TRECVID-wide oracle or a substitute for
  independently verified 2026 evaluation.

### Alternative or multilingual ASR matched panel

- **Hypothesis:** an alternative or multilingual ASR can improve a declared
  speech stratum without hidden changes to the downstream visual pathway.
- **Smallest valid panel or work item:** a matched frozen panel with declared
  source-language/speech strata, including explicit no-speech, rejection, and
  null controls.
- **Matched controls and integrity safeguards:** same downstream frames,
  model, prompt, decoding, panel identities, and scoring; record ASR model,
  revision, language behavior, timestamps, acceptance/rejection, and nulls.
- **Decision or promotion rule:** advance only if the alternative meets its
  predeclared paired improvement and control non-regression criteria against
  current accepted Whisper.
- **Boundary on what a positive result would establish:** it would support the
  tested ASR on that frozen stratum, not multilingual robustness everywhere.
